design_rationale: Existing frozen UTR/Original-DRTP A+B mature 10M endpoints are reused. Only the missing PLR-style external comparator is newly trained, across every pre-existing A/B training seed.

plr_mapping.level: one of six frozen DRTP failure groups
plr_mapping.score: mean absolute unnormalised GAE over vectorised T-step rollout fragments

evaluation.source: reuse the frozen cohort-matched A/B endpoint tape exactly
evaluation.primary_reporting: A and B separate; pooled n=10 descriptive only
